title: PHOENIX CONTACT FL SWITCH
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW IMPROPER AUTHORIZATION CWE-285 A remote unauthenticated attacker may be able to craft special HTTP requests allowing an attacker to bypass web-service authentication allowing the attacker to obtain administrative privileges on the device. CVE-2017-16743 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 9.8 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ). INFORMATION EXPOSURE CWE-200 A remote unauthenticated attacker may be able to use Monitor Mode on the device to read diagnostic information. CVE-2017-16741 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 5.3 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N ). RESEARCHER Ilya Karpov and Evgeniy Druzhinin of Positive Technologies discovered these vulnerabilities. PHOENIX CONTACT reported to CERT@VDE that their products are affected. CERT@VDE coordinated these vulnerabilities with ICS-CERT.
